jobs.title: Real Estate Investment Banking Analyst (class of 2027)
jobs.description:
Cantor Fitzgerald & Co. is seeking highly motivated, analytical, and entrepreneurial candidates for its 2027 Investment Banking Analyst Program within the Real Estate Investment Banking Group. Analysts will work side‑by‑side with senior bankers on mergers & acquisitions, equity and debt financings, strategic advisory, and other complex transactions across a broad spectrum of real‑estate sectors, gaining hands‑on experience and exposure to institutional investors, REITs, private equity sponsors, and public companies.
- Expected graduation between December 2026 and June 2027.
- Pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Real Estate, Business, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field.
- Strong academic record with demonstrated analytical capabilities.
- Prior internship experience in investment banking, real‑estate finance, corporate finance, valuation, consulting, or related fields (preferred).
- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
- Excellent quantitative, financial modeling, and valuation skills.
- Strong written and verbal communication abilities.
- Ability to manage multiple projects and meet tight deadlines.
- High level of professionalism, attention to detail, and commitment to excellence.
- Entrepreneurial mindset and eagerness to work in a fast‑paced, team‑oriented environment.

#LI-PM1
Salary- $100,000 - $125,000 + Bonus
- Support execution of M&A, strategic advisory, and capital‑markets transactions for real‑estate clients.
- Build and maintain detailed financial models, including DCF, NAV, merger, and LBO analyses.
- Prepare client presentations, pitch books, confidential information memoranda, and marketing materials.
- Conduct industry, company, and market research across office, industrial, multifamily, retail, hospitality, data‑center, and alternative asset sectors.
- Perform financial statement analysis and due‑diligence for prospective transactions.
- Coordinate transaction execution with clients, legal counsel, accountants, and other advisors.
- Monitor real‑estate capital markets, industry trends, and comparable transactions.
- Participate in client meetings and internal deal‑team discussions.
- Assist in the preparation of transaction documentation and regulatory filings.
- Maintain internal databases and track deal pipeline activity.
Join Cantor Fitzgerald’s Real Estate Investment Banking Analyst Program (Class of 2027) to support M&A, capital markets, and advisory transactions for real estate clients.

jobs.title: Investment Banking Associate-– Healthcare (Life Sciences / Biotechnology)
jobs.description:

This position involves evaluating new investment opportunities, supporting M&A activities, and assisting with IPO processes. The ideal candidate will have a strong scientific background, excellent communication skills, and a passion for the healthcare industry.
- PhD degree in a biological or life sciences-related field from an accredited institution.
- Strong understanding of complex scientific concepts relevant to biotechnology.
- General knowledge of life sciences and biopharma industry trends and developments.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present scientific information clearly.
- Willingness to work closely with senior bankers and adapt to a dynamic, client-driven work environment.
- Currently residing in or open to relocating to New York.
- Experience in investment banking, consulting, or a related field is preferred but not mandatory.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- A passion for the healthcare industry and a desire to contribute to its growth and innovation.
- Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

#LI-PM1
- Evaluate and analyze investment banking opportunities in life sciences and biotechnology.
- Contribute to client positioning, messaging, and value proposition discussions.
- Develop and maintain pitch materials for business development initiatives.
- Conduct M&A assessments on behalf of clients, including strategic and financial analysis.
- Support the drafting and due diligence process for IPOs, including S-1 preparation.
- Accompany senior bankers to client meetings, pitches, and drafting sessions.
- Develop a deep understanding of client pipeline candidates and their scientific, clinical, and competitive landscapes.
- Conduct industry, company, and product research across various biotechnology therapeutic areas.
- Translate complex scientific concepts into accessible insights for diverse audiences.
- Collaborate closely with senior bankers in a fast-paced, client-centric environment.
Cantor Fitzgerald & Co is seeking a PhD-level Investment Banking Associate to join our Healthcare team, specializing in Life Sciences and Biotechnology. This role offers an opportunity to support senior bankers and contribute to a range of transaction and advisory activities.

jobs.title: Analyst - SPAC Investment Banking
jobs.description:
Cantor Fitzgerald, a renowned financial services firm, seeks an Analyst to join its SPAC Investment Banking team. With a focus on SPAC underwriting and PIPE placements, you'll play a crucial role in supporting the full deal lifecycle, from IPOs to De-SPAC PIPEs. This role offers an opportunity to work with a diverse range of clients and gain exposure to various financial instruments and markets.
- 1+ years of investment banking, ECM, or relevant capital markets experience.
- Advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel, with experience in financial modeling and pitch book production preferred.
- Licensed or willing to obtain SIE, Series 79, and Series 63 licenses.
- Bachelor's degree is required, with a strong academic background in finance, economics, or a related field.
- Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build relationships with clients and colleagues.
- A proactive and detail-oriented approach to work, with a focus on delivering high-quality results.
- A passion for the financial markets and a desire to contribute to the firm's innovative culture.
- Willingness to continuously learn and adapt to the dynamic nature of the SPAC and investment banking landscape.

Salary:  $100,000 - $120,000

#LI-PM1
- Support SPAC transactions, including IPOs and De-SPAC PIPEs, across the entire deal lifecycle.
- Evaluate complex financial models and conduct valuation analyses using DCF, comparable companies, and precedent transactions.
- Create and update client-facing materials such as pitch books, presentations, and investor decks.
- Conduct due diligence on De-SPAC target companies, analyzing business, financial, and market aspects.
- Assist in preparing and reviewing deal documents, including LOIs, term sheets, and SEC filings.
- Perform market research and competitive analyses for SPAC sponsors and clients.
- Monitor SPAC market dynamics, trust performance, and regulatory developments to inform deal strategies.
- Interface with SPAC sponsors, target company management, legal teams, investors, and senior bankers.
- Contribute to the firm's global distribution platform and client advisory services.
Join Cantor Fitzgerald's SPAC Investment Banking team as an Analyst, supporting SPAC transactions and contributing to the firm's global financial services leadership.

jobs.title: Vice President - Consumer and Retail Investment Banking

- Ability to manage multiple live engagements simultaneously, with exceptional communication and client management skills.

- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, or a related field, with strong academic credentials.
- Professional designations such as MBA, CFA, or similar are advantageous, reflecting a commitment to excellence.

#LI-PM1

Lead the Consumer & Retail Investment Banking division at Cantor Fitzgerald & Co. as Vice President, driving M&A and capital markets transactions, client relationships, and strategic initiatives.

jobs.title: Analyst, Metals & Mining Investment Banking
jobs.description:
Cantor Fitzgerald is a diversified company primarily specializing in financial services for institutional and corporate customers operating in the global financial and commercial real estate markets. Cantor is preeminent investment bank serving more than 5,000 institutional clients around the world, recognized for its strengths in equity capital markets and fixed income, investment banking, SPAC underwriting, PIPE placements, commercial real estate, and for its global distribution platform.

At Cantor, our employees are our greatest asset. We look for individuals who are driven, intellectually engaged, team oriented and have a real desire to make an impact.

The Metals & Mining investment banking team of Cantor is seeking a highly motivated, successful candidate to join as an Analyst in its Toronto office. The group advises clients on strategic and financial initiatives including mergers and acquisitions, equity and debt capital raises, restructurings, and other advisory assignments.

Analysts are provided significant responsibility within the full transaction process, including conducting financial analyses, building valuation models, preparing presentation materials, execution of live transactions, conducting due diligence and assistance with new business development. Lean transaction teams provide Analysts with a strong learning platform early in their careers. Candidates must have a strong interest in investment banking, solid quantitative and analytical skills, and the ability to think broadly about strategic issues facing global Metals & Mining clients. A working knowledge of accounting, valuation, finance, and business strategy is required.
- 0-3 years of relevant work experience; prior investment banking experience is not  required, however candidates with investment banking or relevant job experience  is a plus

- Undergraduate degree with strong academic  track record (minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5/4.0, or equivalent)

- Excel grasp of corporate finance, valuation, and financial accounting

- Self-motivated individuals who  demonstrate initiative, drive, and leadership

- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple project deliverables simultaneously

- Strong written and verbal communication skills

Salary- $100,000 - $110,000 (CAD)  + Discretionary Bonus

#LI-PM1
- Coordination of various processes, including capital raises and advisory transactions

- Prepare and analyze historical and projected financial information

- Perform financial analyses and create financial models

- Coordinate industry and company-specific due diligence related to transactions

- Perform industry research to support pitches and new business generation activities using tools such as Bloomberg, S&P Capital IQ, and LSEG Workspace

- Prepare confidential information memoranda, management  presentations and marketing pitches for clients

- Organizing and  participating in marketing and client meetings

- Work closely with senior bankers and deal teams on cross-border transactions, gaining exposure to global markets, investors, and strategic buyers
Join Cantor Fitzgerald's Metals & Mining Investment Banking team in Toronto as an Analyst, supporting M&A, capital raises, and strategic advisory for global mining clients.

jobs.title: Attorney, Investment Banking
jobs.description:
At Cantor Fitzgerald Securities, we are looking for a talented and driven Attorney to support our Investment Banking Division. In this role, you will provide legal expertise and commercial insights, ensuring the efficient and timely execution of securities offerings. As a key member of our team, you will have the chance to make a significant impact and contribute to the success of our business.
- 3-5+ years of debt and/or equity capital markets legal experience at a top-tier law firm or investment bank.
- Significant expertise in advising investment banks on IPOs, Shelf-takedowns, and other ECM deals.
- Proficiency in negotiating with auditors and issuer's counsels for comfort letters and legal opinions.
- Solid understanding of federal securities laws and New York/Delaware corporate law.
- Strong drafting skills, particularly for engagement letters, NDAs, and purchase/placement agreements.
- Excellent academic credentials, including a J.D. from an ABA-accredited US law school.
- Admission to the NY State Bar in good standing is mandatory.
- Willingness to take on drafting responsibilities and work with minimal precedents.
- Exceptional writing, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-pressure environment and interface with senior executives.

#LI-EM1
- Advise on legal, regulatory, and reputational matters for the Investment Banking Division.
- Supervise outside counsel on various capital markets offerings, including IPOs, SPACs, and securitizations.
- Review, negotiate, and draft transaction documents, such as engagement letters and underwriting agreements.
- Coordinate globally with legal and compliance colleagues to stay updated on securities regulations.
- Assist in obtaining internal approvals and ensuring proper governance for securities offerings.
- Liaise with Investment Banking Compliance and Sales & Trading Legal to promote regulatory compliance.
- Research and provide insights on new and proposed securities laws and regulations.
- Support the creation of internal policies and procedures to maintain compliance.
- Collaborate with deal teams and operational teams to execute securities offerings efficiently.
We are seeking an experienced Attorney to join our Investment Banking team, offering a unique opportunity to advise on legal matters and drive the execution of securities offerings.
